description: The LOCALE keyword of FUNCTION NUMVAL-C / TEST-NUMVAL-C (argument-1 LOCALE [locale-name-1] [ANYCASE]), ISO 15.68.2 / 15.94.2 - introduced 2002 with the locale facility (Annex A.4.9 item 12; kb/Work PB64 T6): argument-1 read under the named-else-current LC_MONETARY locale (15.68.3 r5). ONE row covers both functions - 15.94.3 r1 imports 15.68.3 whole. NUMVAL-C itself is 1985; the keyword is gated in the binder (BindNumvalCFamily) like case-function-locale-phrase-2014.
